adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best the line `embed_url = params.require(:embed_url)` will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing` when the param is absent, and there is no local `rescue`/explicit response for that case in this controller. The spec (`it "is 404 without an embed_url" do get :best; response.should_not be_success end`) only asserts non-success and does not define a specific status/body contract.
